selection: Use the two published labelled N11 parents with their unchanged named four-point past and future collars. Insert two marked inner events (11 then 12) allowing below, above and incomparable relations. Require exactly the old induced relation after each deletion. The insertion order is computational, not dust time.
structure: Enumerate ALL marked two-insertion paths, both intermediate deletion orders, canonical endpoint geometries, scalar admissibility at BOTH sizes and dependence on the deletion order. Independent check via labelled orbits of forward-transitive masks. Positive path laws on obstructed sectors are undefined for the inherited readout.
weights: Compare equal admissible marked insertions at each step with equal jointly admissible complete marked paths per original parent. Both retain the original 1/2 per N11 parent. Tabulate exact endpoint total-variation distance and swap asymmetry for complete labelled assignments to the two new points.
amplitudes: Apply unchanged scalar rigging, phases, compact clocks, two past-density packets, five control preparations and q7 detector. Compute all reachable, sequentially admissible endpoints for which exact variable elimination peaks at no more than THREE clocks at a time. Count other endpoints, never silently assign amplitudes to them. For explicitly width-conditioned weight laws, retain an N12 parent at its original weight if it has no eligible child and identify it. Test equal marked and distinct-shape per-step splitting.
nested: Start with N11 weights 1/2 and 1/2. At N11 transfer lambda of both parents to N12 as in v0.2. At N12 transfer mu only from the N12 portion to N13; held N11 weights stay fixed. Compare (lambda,mu) in {0,0.05,1} x {0,0.05,0.5,1}. Report against N11 and its immediately preceding N11+N12 state. Distinguish total N13 weight from the transferred N12 fraction.
gate: v0.2 thresholds. Each density level TV <= 0.10 times the anchor success, contrast half-L1 change <= 0.25 times the anchor signed four-outcome contrast half-L1, same nonzero success-delta sign. Sign diagnostics over the whole computed support if possible.
controls: First compare tensor elimination to direct Cartesian quadrature on every measured new shape on an order-4 grid. Use (32,6),(48,8), then (64,10) or (80,12) as needed until change of amplitudes <3e-10. Compare the last two outcome matrices (<5e-12), reproduce v0.2 and test independent damped scalar integration at epsilon=1e-28. Track numerical rather than interval-certified integration errors.
compute: Only local CPU and already installed packages. No hosted job or cloud compute.
